newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA 91-DAY T-BILL ISSUE FULLY SUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA 91-DAY T-BILL ISSUE FULLY SUBSCRIBED.

text.p: An issue of 643.24 billion lei worth of Romanian three-month treasury bills was fully sold last week, central bank (BNR) data showed on Monday.

Twelve banks and their clients bought the Finance Ministry's floating-rate bills. The papers offer an annual yield calculated at an average of the BNR's weekly auctioned credit rates during their life period.
Last week, the average auctioned rate fell to 226.31 percent from a previous 426.5 percent after the BNR's offer was undersubscribed.
